title: Nvidia’s SVP of networking explains the 5 types of networks needed for AI factories

title: AI data centers need a new control plane for power, cooling and compute
content: AI data centers are outgrowing siloed operations. As power, cooling and compute become tightly intertwined, operators need orchestration layers that can coordinate the whole stack in real time.
